scope: off-only discovery; not an optimization price, support claim or impossibility proof

refusal_reasons.live_template_arguments: Fresh helper arguments/locals/output escape through live sends; freezing, sharing or deleting requires a callee contract.
refusal_reasons.tag_fragments: Live key/value conversions, escaping, options iteration and helper dispatch; fusion removes or changes sends.
refusal_reasons.safe_buffer: Live html_safe?/constructor/escaping dispatch and fresh escaping output; not a dead literal pool.
refusal_reasons.escaping: Live conversion/escaping dispatch; even a literal XML-name Symbol uses to_s, blank? and match?.
refusal_reasons.route_work: Live parameterization/URL methods, scopes and options; no syntax-only elimination identified.
refusal_reasons.model_work: Live values, casts, callbacks, attribute/association dispatch; no syntax-only elimination identified.
refusal_reasons.app_work: Application sends and mutable data remain live; no exact local rewrite established.
refusal_reasons.other_live_or_unresolved: No by-construction rewrite established; gross pool is NOT a proven removable ceiling.

arithmetic_stays_a_send.source: eval("def f; 1 + 2; end"); original = f; Integer.class_eval { def +(other); 99; end }; live = f; folded = 3; puts [original, live, folded].inspect

freezing_helper_arguments_changes_behavi.source: a = eval(%q{"key"}); b = eval(%q{"key".freeze}); x = (a << "!"); y = begin b << "!"; rescue => e; e.class.name; end; puts [x,y].inspect

combining_appends_changes_dispatch.source: class Buffer; attr_reader :calls; def initialize; @calls=[]; end; def safe_append=(s); @calls << s; end; end; a=Buffer.new; a.safe_append="left"; a.safe_append="right"; b=Buffer.new; b.safe_append="leftright"; puts [a.calls,b.calls].inspect

fresh_options_cannot_be_shared.source: def use(h); h[:seen] = h.fetch(:seen,0) + 1; end; a=[use({}),use({})]; h={}; b=[use(h),use(h)]; puts [a,b].inspect
